title: Decide whether a cheap proxy can rank architectures
description: Choose a candidate-evaluation proxy, then change how many finalists and repeated seeds receive full confirmation. Inspect correlation, bias, hardware match, and confirmation cost together.

scenarios.label: Matched partial training
scenarios.detail: Uses the target data, compiler, and hardware with a shorter but calibrated training schedule.

scenarios.label: Weight-sharing supernet
scenarios.detail: Candidates inherit shared weights; operation and path interference distort some architecture families.

scenarios.label: Low-resolution surrogate
scenarios.detail: Cheap input resolution changes the compute and receptive-field trade-offs that matter at deployment.

scenarios.label: Unmatched latency lookup
scenarios.detail: Uses operation timings from another accelerator and ignores compiler fusion and memory behavior.
